title: Understand KV Store Engine Migration and Upgrade Preparation
objectives: Understand KV Store Engine Migration and Upgrade Preparation
Verify actual state through a separate inspection or query.

tasks.instruction: This is upgrade preparation, not a real MongoDB migration. Inspect KV status: the simulator reports synthetic serverVersion 7.0.0 and a broken mmapv1 storage setting. Read docs/V6-KVSTORE.md for the modeled boundary.

Stage storageEngine=wiredTiger in server.conf [kvstore], restart sh01 and inspect readiness. Take v7_upgrade_ready backup only after the supported engine is active; compare its records to current data. Real binary migration, vendor compatibility and native backup archives are outside this exercise.

hints: Inspect running versus disk source and use the correct component.
Keep the fixture clock paused and advance deliberately to observe transitions.

references.purpose: Searchable restart and available copy preflight
Deployer source, target and merge_to_default behavior
Collection schema and data endpoint families; virtual execution boundary documented

checks.label: Supported engine, current replicas and verified preparation backup

feedback.success: Verified operational state and independent evidence are retained in this isolated attempt.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect current source, service state, operation receipts and replica data.
